journey.title: Choose 'No symptoms' after ticking symptoms with the keyboard
journey.goal: Ticking the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' answer clears the symptoms ticked earlier

functionalJourney.title: Tick two symptoms with a pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Both ticked symptoms are submitted and no-symptoms stays clear

guards.title: Choose 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method
guards.goal: The exclusive answer in a shared-name group clears the method ticked earlier

plan.root_cause: The import map lacks an entry for the checkboxes component module, so the initCheckboxes() call fails and the exclusive checkbox behavior is not applied.
plan.repair_strategy: Add the missing import map entry for './packages/nhsuk-frontend/src/nhsuk/components/checkboxes/checkboxes.js' to allow the module to load and initCheckboxes() to run, restoring exclusive functionality.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Ensures that selecting the mutually exclusive 'No symptoms' option clears other symptom selections via keyboard, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Adding the module may affect other pages if they unexpectedly rely on its absence, but the component is benign when not used.
If another import map entry for the same specifier exists, duplication could cause conflicts; however the current map lacks this entry.
verification_requirements: After pressing Space on #symptoms-none, verify that symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] are unchecked.
Confirm that the exclusive group works for both mouse clicks and keyboard interaction.
Ensure no console errors related to module loading appear after the change.
